tool_results.name: search_store_docs
tool_results.content:
[POL-002] Shipping and Delivery Policy
Shipping and Delivery Policy > Shipping fees

- **Free standard shipping** on orders of **2,000 EGP or more** to Cairo and Giza.
- Standard shipping to Cairo and Giza for smaller orders: **50 EGP**.
- Standard shipping to all other governorates: **75 EGP**, free on orders of **5,000 EGP or more**.
- Express delivery: **120 EGP**, never free.
- Large items (TVs over 55 inches, gaming chairs) have a fixed fee of **150 EGP** outside Cairo and Giza.

[POL-006] Order Cancellation Policy
Order Cancellation Policy > Partial cancellation

For orders with several items, you can cancel individual items before the order ships. Free shipping is recalculated: if the remaining total drops below the free shipping threshold, the standard fee is added.

[POL-002] Shipping and Delivery Policy
Shipping and Delivery Policy > Delivery areas and times

| Area | Standard delivery | Express delivery |
|---|---|---|
| Cairo and Giza | 1 to 2 business days | Same day (order before 2 PM) |
| Alexandria, Delta and Canal cities | 2 to 4 business days | Next business day |
| Upper Egypt, Red Sea and Sinai | 3 to 6 business days | Not available |  
Business days are Sunday to Thursday, excluding public holidays.

[POL-002] Shipping and Delivery Policy
Shipping and Delivery Policy > Failed delivery

The courier tries to deliver **twice**. If both attempts fail, the order returns to our warehouse and is cancelled. Prepaid orders are refunded minus the shipping fee.

[POL-006] Order Cancellation Policy
Order Cancellation Policy > Cancelling before shipping

You can cancel an order for free while its status is **Pending** or **Confirmed**. Open My Orders and choose **Cancel Order**. Prepaid orders are refunded in full to the original payment method.

d2.answer:
For deliveries to Alexandria, the standard shipping fee is 75 EGP [POL-002]. Standard shipping becomes free for orders totaling 5,000 EGP or more [POL-002]. 

Please note that for large items (such as TVs over 55 inches or gaming chairs), there is a fixed shipping fee of 150 EGP for all locations outside Cairo and Giza [POL-002]. Express delivery is also available for 120 EGP, though it is never free [POL-002].

[POL-005] Instalment Plans
Instalment Plans > Bank card instalments

- **0% interest for 6 months** with cards from partner banks (CIB, Banque Misr, National Bank of Egypt, QNB).
- **12 months** are available with an interest rate set by your bank.
- The instalment plan is chosen on the payment page; your bank converts the purchase within one billing cycle.

[POL-005] Instalment Plans
Instalment Plans > Returns on instalment orders

If you return a product bought in instalments, ShopMind cancels the transaction with the bank or finance company. Any administrative fees charged by the bank or finance company are not refundable by ShopMind.

[POL-005] Instalment Plans
Instalment Plans

You can pay for orders of **3,000 EGP or more** in monthly instalments.

[POL-004] Payment Methods Policy
Payment Methods

We accept the following payment methods:  
- **Credit and debit cards:** Visa, Mastercard and Meeza.
- **Cash on delivery (COD):** available for orders up to **15,000 EGP**. A fee of **15 EGP** is added to COD orders.
- **Mobile wallets:** Vodafone Cash, Orange Cash, Etisalat Cash and InstaPay.
- **Instalments:** see the Instalment Plans policy.
- **ShopMind wallet balance and gift cards.**

[POL-005] Instalment Plans
Instalment Plans > Consumer finance companies

- valU, Contact, Souhoola and Aman: plans from **6 to 36 months**.
- You need an active account with the finance company. Approval and limits are decided by them, not by ShopMind.
- A down payment may be required depending on your limit.

d3.answer:
Yes, you can pay in instalments without interest! We offer 0% interest for 6 months when using credit cards from our partner banks: CIB, Banque Misr, National Bank of Egypt, and QNB [POL-005].

Please note that instalment plans are available for orders of 3,000 EGP or more [POL-005]. You can select your preferred instalment plan directly on the payment page during checkout [POL-005].

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy

At ShopMind Electronics we want you to be happy with every purchase. This policy explains when and how you can return a product and how refunds are paid.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Exchanges

You can exchange a product for a different model or colour within the same return window. If the new product costs more, you pay the difference; if it costs less, we refund the difference.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Return windows

- **Unopened products:** you can return them within **30 days** of delivery for a full refund.
- **Opened products in perfect condition:** you can return them within **14 days** of delivery. The product must include all original accessories, manuals and packaging.
- **Defective products:** if a product stops working within the first **30 days**, we replace it or refund it in full, whether it was opened or not. After 30 days, defects are handled under the warranty policy.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > How to start a return

1. Open **My Orders** in your account and select the order.
2. Choose **Request Return**, pick the items and the reason.
3. Our team reviews the request within **2 business days**.
4. Once approved, a courier collects the item from your address for free (Cairo and Giza) or you can drop it at any ShopMind branch.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Products that cannot be returned

- Items sold in the **Clearance** section are final sale and cannot be returned unless they are defective.
- Opened software, gift cards, and digital licence codes.
- In-ear headphones and earbuds once the hygiene seal is broken, unless they are defective.
- Products damaged by misuse, liquid, drops, or unauthorised repair.

[SM-PH-005] Google Pixel 10a
Google Pixel 10a

**Price:** 24,999 EGP
**Warranty:** 12 months  
Google's affordable Pixel with the best camera processing in its class and clean Android with fast updates. Clearance item: final sale.

[SM-PH-005] Google Pixel 10a
Google Pixel 10a > Key specs

- 6.1-inch OLED, 90Hz
- 128 GB storage, 8 GB RAM
- 64 MP main camera
- Seven years of updates

d8.answer:
Yes, you can return the Pixel 10a if you change your mind, provided it meets the return conditions. However, please note that the Google Pixel 10a is listed as a clearance item, and according to our policy, clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned unless they are defective [POL-001, SM-PH-005].

If the item is not a clearance item, our return policy for changing your mind is as follows:
- **Unopened products:** You can return them within 30 days of delivery for a full refund [POL-001].
- **Opened products in perfect condition:** You can return them within 14 days of delivery, provided they include all original accessories, manuals, and packaging [POL-001].

To start a return, you can go to "My Orders" in your account and select "Request Return" [POL-001].
